patch.value: Round 4 on PR 67: land the compound-line, sibling-branch and case-arm scope fixes in this vendored scanner and clear all four review threads

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Round 4 measured evidence, all against this repo's own verifier:

(1) Compound-line assignments (Greptile P1, thread PRRT_kwDOSZpews6d3N0P). Reverted only the segment-split change in scalarAssignments back to the start-anchored remainder loop and ran node --test test/verify-release-publish-attestation.test.ts: 58 pass / 1 fail, the failure being 'a compound one-line assignment after then is recorded, so a variable-routed publish is audited' — the shape if true; then NPM=npm; $NPM publish; fi leaves $NPM unbound, the publish is never recognised, and an attested sibling satisfies the non-vacuity guard (failures: [] overall). With the fix: green.

(2) Sibling if-branches (Greptile P1, thread PRRT_kwDOSZpews6d3N0f). Removed only the startsNewBranch pop from publishInvocationsIn: 58 pass / 1 fail, failing 'a binding in one if branch is not visible in a sibling branch' — FLAG=--provenance in the then arm attested npm publish $FLAG in the else arm at the same numeric depth. With the fix: green, and the mirrors hold (outer binding visible in both branches; same-branch binding still attests).

(3) Sibling case arms (CodeRabbit Major, thread PRRT_kwDOSZpews6d3Qvz). Removed only the endsCaseArm pop: 58 pass / 1 fail, failing 'a binding in one case arm is not visible in a sibling arm'. With the fix: green, and the same-arm mirror holds.

(4) Full suite with all three fixes: 254 pass / 0 fail (node --test, 62s).

(5) Closure metadata (CodeRabbit Minor, thread PRRT_kwDOSZpews6d3Qvv). The prior attempt hand-reordered pm-todos-9clr history lines; measured pm health --strict-exit = exit 1 with history_drift_chain_mismatch and history_drift_hash_mismatch (gate_failing), because reordering an append-only hash-chained ledger breaks the chain. Redone chain-validly: history restored to the committed chain, then pm update --status open followed by pm close with the complete reason, so the final close event is appended after the last review entry. pm health --strict-exit now exits 0 and pm validate is ok with history_drift ok.

Scope-identity design note: else/elif and ;; are recognised as unquoted keywords exactly like the pre-existing BLOCK_OPENERS/BLOCK_CLOSERS word shapes (if/for/while/until/case/select, fi/done/esac), so precision is consistent with the file's established convention; popping is bounded by depth so enclosing-scope bindings survive, each direction covered by its own test.

patch.value: Four unresolved PR-67 review threads addressed at the source: compound-line assignments (Greptile P1), sibling if-branch bindings (Greptile P1), sibling case-arm bindings and scope identity (CodeRabbit major), closure-metadata sync (CodeRabbit minor).
Each new regression test fails when its fix is reverted and passes with it; full suite green; pm health strict exit 0; changelog check passes with CHANGELOG.md committed.

58 pass / 1 fail for each isolated revert (compound-line, if-branch, case-arm); 254 pass / 0 fail with all fixes; pm health --strict-exit exit 0 with history_drift ok; changelog:check reports up to date.

Landed the round-4 review fixes in this vendored scanner and repaired the closure metadata chain-validly. Compound one-line assignments after then/else/elif/do are now recorded by splitting a line on unquoted semicolons before the anchored match, so a variable-routed publish inside a one-line compound is audited instead of invisible behind an attested sibling. Sibling if-branches and case arms no longer share bindings: else/elif and a case arm's ;; pop same-depth bindings, while enclosing-scope bindings survive, each direction covered by its own test. pm-todos-9clr's closure metadata now follows its final fix history via a chain-valid reopen and re-close, after measuring that hand-reordering the hash-chained history broke pm health's history-drift gate (exit 1, chain and hash mismatch). All three regression tests verified red with their fix reverted; 254/254 pass; coverage thresholds met; pm health --strict-exit exits 0; changelog regenerated and checked.

message: Close round 4: fixes landed, gates green, threads to be resolved referencing this change
